content_of_post_to_comment:
the way i rush through emails is the same way i rush the gym and the same way i half listen when someone's talking to me.

i used to think those were three different problems. they're not. it's one move. something feels uncomfortable and i just want it over with.

once i saw that i started seeing it everywhere, not just rushing.

if i don't know how something's gonna go i overplan it into the ground and never start. if it gets boring i jump to whatever's new. if there's conflict i go quiet and call it being easygoing. if it actually gets hard i just lower the bar and pretend that was the plan.

it's like you don't have five issues. you have one default and it wears whatever the day's about.

mine's the rush/bail thing. i usually only notice after i already did it.

what's yours. and do you catch it while it's happening or only later when you're already annoyed at yourself
